place.eventDescription: One Google Maps place delivered as a full row, every detail included: phone, website, rating, review count, hours, address parts, coordinates (row keys place_id, cid, google_maps_url, name, category, phone, website, rating, review_count, opening_hours, address, street, city, postal_code, country_code, lat, lng, is_closed_permanently). $4 per 1,000 places. All filters are free and run BEFORE this charge: places your filters reject, duplicates, places an earlier monitored run delivered, empty or failed searches and unknown locations cost $0. No start fee, proxy and compute included in the event price; charged count always equals delivered rows. The run stops at the maximum cost per run you set when starting it (Apify run option maxTotalChargeUsd), never above it.

contact-found.eventDescription: When enrichContacts (or onlyWithEmail) is on: $3 per 1,000 places where an email or social/WhatsApp link is found on the place's own website, in addition to the $4 per 1,000 base place fee (row keys emails, email_primary, phones_from_site, contact_page_url, facebook, instagram, linkedin, x, youtube, tiktok, whatsapp, enrichment_status). No website, unreachable website, phone-only findings or no contact found = no contact fee. At the historical 50% contact yield, 1,000 enriched places cost about $5.50 total ($4 base + $1.50 contacts); yield is not guaranteed. With onlyWithEmail, each delivered place has an email and costs $0.007 total: 50 delivered places cost $0.35; places without an email are omitted and free. Proxy and compute are included in these event prices.
